chunks: He, by Allah, is ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (peace be upon him).

key_terms.بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ: son of Abī Ṭālib; the lineage designation of Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام)
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific invocation for Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام)
key_terms.عَلِيُّ: ʿAlī; Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (عليه السلام)
key_terms.هُوَ: He; the one being identified in the statement
key_terms.وَاللَّهِ: By Allah; an oath used for emphasis and certainty

ai.seo_question: Who is meant by “the believers” in the verse, “And say: Work; so Allah will see your work and His Messenger and the believers”?
ai.summary: This statement identifies the referent of “the believers” in the verse as Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (عليه السلام). It highlights his unique spiritual authority and his special station in relation to the witnessing of deeds.
